items.title: Distributed Datalog at Scale with Worst-Case Optimal Joins
items.summary: arXiv:2610.12692v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scalable logic-based analytics are frequently dominated by cyclic multi-way joins over large relational datasets. Worst-Case Optimal Joins (WCOJ) offer a provably superior alternative by evaluating joins one variable at a…
